turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Reddy?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Reddy. Who is this?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Sir, I am Ananya from the cardiology department at the clinic in Bengaluru. I am calling to confirm your appointment for tomorrow morning.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Tomorrow? I thought it was on Wednesday. Let me check my diary.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is scheduled for 10 AM tomorrow, sir. Also, your latest scan reports have arrived and are ready for pickup at the front desk.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, the reports are here already? I was getting worried about the delay.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, they are all set. Please bring your ID card when you visit tomorrow.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay. Will there be a lot of waiting time for the doctor?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We will try our best to see you on time, Mr. Reddy. Just a heads up, the total bill for the tests and consultation will be around eighty thousand rupees.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Eighty thousand? My goodness, that is quite a lot of money.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I understand, sir. You can just settle the payment at the billing counter after your appointment.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Alright, I will bring my cheque book. Thank you for reminding me, beta.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You are welcome, sir. We will see you tomorrow at 10 AM. Goodbye.
